Container.Name: Recovery-Curator
Container.Overview: Non-destructive recovery triage with saved scans, known-good comparison, photo/video analysis, a sanitation-first review library, space-saving hardlinks, conservative metadata repair, and optional conversational AI labeling.
Container.Requires: Mount the common parent of source, output, and quarantine once at /recovery-data. Keep ALLOW_ACTIONS=false for the first scan. Store appdata on a non-array pool.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Recovery Curator web interface

Config.Name: Recovery Workspace
Config.Description: One common host parent containing the recovered source, curated output, and quarantine folders. Docker must see these through this single mapping for hardlinks to work.

Config.Name: Recovered Source Subfolder
Config.Description: Relative folder beneath Recovery Workspace containing the recovered files. Example: Hard Drive Recovered Files

Config.Name: Curated Output Subfolder
Config.Description: Relative folder beneath Recovery Workspace for the sanitized mirror. It must not be inside the recovered source.

Config.Name: Quarantine Subfolder
Config.Description: Relative folder beneath Recovery Workspace for reversible quarantine actions.

Config.Name: Known-Good Subfolder
Config.Description: Optional relative folder beneath Recovery Workspace containing trusted backups. Use a single period (.) when the workspace itself is the known-good root. Leave blank to use an optional separate /known-good mapping.

Config.Name: Optional External Known-Good Root
Config.Description: Optional separate read-only known-good parent when it is outside Recovery Workspace. Leave this mapping empty when Known-Good Subfolder is set.

Config.Name: Shared Workspace Mode
Config.Description: Internal shared workspace path. Keep /recovery-data to preserve hardlink support.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: SQLite catalog, scan state, and reports. Prefer cache storage.

Config.Name: Allow Write Actions
Config.Description: Leave false for scanning/review. Set true only when ready to build the curated output or quarantine files.

Config.Name: Analysis Workers
Config.Description: One worker is optimized for this recovery set residing on a single pool drive.

Config.Name: Hash Workers
Config.Description: One sequential full-file reader prevents seek contention on the single source drive.

Config.Name: Checkpoint Batch
Config.Description: Maximum in-memory work batch and checkpoint interval. 64 is recommended.

Config.Name: Photo Similarity Distance
Config.Description: Perceptual hash distance from 0-16. Six is conservative; higher creates broader groups.

Config.Name: Optional AI API Key
Config.Description: Optional credential injected as an environment variable. The easier setup is to paste a key in the Web UI. If you use this field instead, open Advanced settings in the Web UI and enter RECOVERY_AI_API_KEY as the environment-variable name. Local providers often leave this blank.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Unraid users group

Config.Name: Curated Output Owner UID
Config.Description: Ownership assigned to independent repaired clones and generated reports. Hardlinks retain the recovered source inode owner.

Config.Name: Curated Output Owner GID
Config.Description: Group assigned to independent repaired clones and reports. Hardlinks retain the source inode group.

Config.Name: Umask
Config.Description: Permissions mask for created files
